text.tspan: Procedure 2026/0011(COD). Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); steps done (blue) and in progress (orange) as of 30 Sep 2026. Lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see csa2.html).
ITRE committee stage: draft report 18 Sep 2026
Working party; no Council mandate yet
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading.
Cyprus Presidency – Horizontal Working Party on Cyber Issues (15 meetings)
ITRE (lead) with IMCO and BUDG opinions

• Status as of 25 Sep 2026: first reading, committee stage in the EP; no Council mandate for negotiations (not public). No trilogue has taken place.
• The Directive amending NIS 2 (COM(2026) 13, procedure 2026/0012(COD)) is negotiated together with this Regulation in the Council (ST 9399/26 covers both).
• Several Member States asked the Council Legal Service to examine the legal basis (ST 9399/26, point 16).
Sources: EP Open Data API (procedure events), Cellar procedure file and Council register documents (ST numbers), EUR-Lex. Our own compilation, not an official record.
